notes:
OCRelay 1.1.23

NEW: US DVT (UPPER EXTREMITY)

• New "US DVT" study in the Study picker, with "Upper Extremity" as its first type. The lower extremity study will be added there later.
• Each vein's circled + or − becomes its line in the report: patent and compressible, occlusive or nonocclusive thrombus, or not visualized. A "+" alone becomes "Thrombus present.", and the review panel asks you to choose occlusive or nonocclusive.
• Abnormal/flat phasic flow rewrites the Flow line. A red alert appears while any vein shows thrombus, because the impression still reads negative.

NEW: PELVIS ROUTE, DOPPLER AND FINDINGS

• OCRelay now fills the exam route (transabdominal, transvaginal, or both) and the Doppler: both ovaries, right only, left only, or not performed.
• The findings the worksheet marks are written in: uterus, endometrium, each ovary and adnexa, cul-de-sac fluid, and additional findings. Organs marked normal keep the report's normal sentence.
• A red alert appears when findings are written or ovarian flow is marked absent.

BOTH STUDIES

• The impression is never written. You dictate it.
• A line that already says the right thing is left alone, so its pick list stays live.

FIX: REPEATED LINES

• When a report repeats the same sentence (the two pelvis ovary lines, for example), a change to the second copy could land on the first. Each change now goes to the right line.
